Reference the intestate property of late Mr. Rathnayaka Wasala Mohottalalage Chithrasiri resides in the village of 387 -Mahalloluwa, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Dompe, in the District of Gampaha. It is hereby notified that any person/s who have a claim to or inyterest in the intestate property of the late Mr.Rathnayaka Wasala Mohottalalage Chithrasiri in the Schedule hereto should submit his/their claim to the undersigned in writing before 11th March, 2024 stating his/their right or interest to such intestate property.
